title: Even Beasts Stumble
description: You find someone in danger in the outskirts of Sumeru...

mainQuestExcel.title: Even Beasts Stumble
mainQuestExcel.description: You find someone in danger in the outskirts of Sumeru...

flow.stepDescription: Rescue the person surrounded by monsters

dialogs.text: Whew. Thanks, Traveler...
It's good to see they're alright.
I'm Elber, a businessman. I was just relaxing here...
I never expected to get attacked by those hilichurls...
Didn't you have any guard with you?
We have heard in town that normally merchants would hire the Eremites to escort their goods.
Well, that costs you Mora...
The prices they asked for were just astronomical.
I'm running a small business. Can't afford that kind of price...
I thought, well, I know a thing or two about fighting monsters anyway, and it's not a long haul, so I might as well go on my own.
But I didn't expect the hilichurls to spook my two Sumpter Beasts.
I was run down by one before I could even react, and when I came to my feet, I got kicked by the other one.
Uh-oh...
They soon ran away, and I was besieged by the hilichurls... Lucky for me, you were here to help.
But all my stuff is on those two Sumpter Beasts... Traveler, could you please help bring them back for me?
I don't want to get kicked...
Don't worry. They are gentle in nature, it's just those hilichurls knocked over their food.
They had traveled so far with the loads and were very hungry. That's why they got so restive after their food was knocked over...
So they were disrupted when eating and their food was messed up...
Ugh... Paimon is getting angry just thinking about that!
You are quick to catch on to that, Paimon.
Well, I'll just leave the food to you.
Please feed the Sumpter Beasts when you find them.
They won't throw tantrums as long as there's food.
I noticed one of them knocked over the hilichurls and ran away...
The other one seems to have been taken away by the hilichurls.
I'll mark their locations roughly and leave the rest to you, Traveler.
You'll be fairly paid for the return of my goods!
They could knock me over...
No one was protecting you?
It was nothing.
*sigh* You simply can't disturb Sumpter Beasts while they're eating.
This one... looks a bit irritated...
Whoa... Look at its hooves. So sturdy.
People could get stunned by a mere kick.
Paimon, you can feed it.
No! You go! Hurry!
Please enjoy your food...
No offense to your hooves...
The Sumpter Beast slowly swallows the food. It seems less restive now...
It seems less angry now.
Let's bring it back. Careful, don't get kicked...
You go back to Elber with the Sumpter Beast...
Whew... I thought I'd lost it.
Thank you, Traveler. I can't express my gratitude enough.
I must check its condition now. Hope it wasn't hurt...
Traveler, please help me find the other Sumpter Beast.
Besides this one, there was another Sumpter Beast that had wandered off.
Luckily, this one's looking good.
Traveler, please help me find the other one.
This one... looks a bit irritated...
Whoa... Look at its hooves. So sturdy.

You go back to Elber with the Sumpter Beast...
You got my two Sumpter Beasts back! Thank you so much, Traveler!
I'll return to the city as soon as I get the goods in order.
*sigh* I'll make sure to hire some escorts next time...
Whoa! This Sumpter Beast is huge. It must hurt so bad getting kicked by it.
Feed it with the food Mr. Elber gave us.
Nice and slow...
Are these enough for it...?
The Sumpter Beast gulps down the food. It seems to be in a better mood now...
It seems to be in a good mood.

flow.stepDescription: Take the goods back to Elber

dialogs.text: Now both Sumpter Beasts are back... Thank you so much, Traveler.
About the goods...
Great! I can't thank you enough, Traveler!
I could have gone broke if I'd lost the goods and these two Sumpter Beasts.
Don't mention it.
Oh, yes, your payment... Please wait a second.
Please take these. I can tell from your looks that you have been venturing around.
I happen to be in the business of those gears. You could use all these.
Whew... The Sumpter Beasts have been recovered and the goods are mostly intact. I should be off.
Thanks again, Traveler.
About our payment...
About the goods...
